blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A couple was shot dead allegedly by the former live-in partner of one of the victims in Bukidnon on Wednesday evening, November 25, police said. The Impasugong police station said that a 43-year-old woman and her 52-year-old live-in partner were shot dead inside their home in Sitio Ulayanon, Barangay Kalabugao, around 6:55 p.m. Police said the suspect is the woman’s former live-in partner, who remains at large. Initial investigation showed the victim’s daughter witnessed her biological father allegedly shoot her mother and stepfather.
